mentions.name: AccessMRF
mentions.description: A catalog of all American health care prices that indexes machine-readable price transparency files published by insurers. To handle the massive volume of data, it builds a taxonomy and performs extensive deduplication (using minhashing) to shrink the dataset by roughly four orders of magnitude, then exposes the data via an API. It is not consumer-grade yet.
mentions.problem: Healthcare price transparency files contain way too much data; the project deduplicates and taxonomizes it to make the problem tractable.
mentions.audience: helps researchers and founders in the space access the data via API, it is not consumer-grade yet
mentions.source_excerpt: I have been working on https://www.accessmrf.com - a catalog of all American health care prices. Since there's way too much data, I am building a taxonomy and deduplicating it extensively first, with the idea that I can shrink it by ~4 orders of magnitude and make the problem tractable.
